title: Implement item economy reset/timer executor (F5/F7 item semantic reset owner)
description:
Close the missing F5/F7 item boundary identified in the 2026-07-19 pre-re-freeze gap review: canonical pack-bound magic items have NO engine executor for their declared reset specs or state-machine timers. restore_usage's description already points at 'their semantic reset owner', but no such owner exists — itemState.ts exports no reset/regain function, no tool applies mechanics.economies[*].reset, and item pendingTimers are scheduled inside useItem with a comment deferring execution to 'the future F5/F7 scheduler/reset boundary' that was never built.

Symptoms today:
- reset: [{at:'dawn', amount:'1d6+4'}] is never applied by the engine; staff/wand charges only ever decrease deterministically, dawn regains are model-narrated.
- Item stateMachine timer transitions and machine duration never fire from the clock (e.g. cube-of-force barrier 1-minute expiry is listed in pendingTimers at use time and nothing ever resolves it).
- Budget economies (winged-boots flight, boots-of-speed) never regain via their per-period/long-rest reset declarations; cooldown availableAt is never set or honored by a scheduler; per-day 'all' resets at dawn never happen.

Scope: a deterministic executor that walks item_state rows and applies, against the campaign clock (clock.elapsed_minutes) and the F7 rest events:
- economy resets for every declared shape: {at: dawn|dusk|short-rest|long-rest|hour|days|per-period, amount: DiceExpr|'all'|DurationSpec, days?, period?, onlyIfUnused?} — seeded dice through the campaign RNG with recorded evidence, clamped to max; define and document anchoring semantics (what elapsed-minute anchor 'dawn'/'dusk' resolve to; per-period anchor point; onlyIfUnused definition) — if any pack reset shape proves ambiguous or insufficient, that is a pack schema finding to surface, not to work around;
- pendingTimers resolution when the clock passes deadlineElapsedMinutes (reuse the itemTimers anchor/deadline validation and the 2n1t.8.1 stable-recovery resolve pattern: resolution hooked into advance_time/rest completion, applied through the authoritative item-state write path with validateItemStateForRecord);
- onDepleted interplay on regain (regainOn results) and lifecycle statuses respected (inert/nonmagical items do not regain);
- wiring: advance_time (update_clock), complete_short_rest / complete_long_rest (F7), and an explicit dawn/dusk boundary derived from the clock — decide and document whether dawn is a clock-derived event or a semantic DM tool call, mirroring how rest events are DM-narrated today.

Rationale for priority (pre-re-freeze recommendation from the 2026-07-19 gap review): this is the single largest untested consumer of pack mechanics data — all 240 items' reset/timer/duration shapes — and therefore the most likely near-term engine work to surface a pack data-model defect that would force a post-freeze thaw. Recommended to land (with the PR #455-style adversarial review bar) BEFORE eshyra-o9bd.14 re-freezes the pack; if that ordering is confirmed, wire it with: bd dep add eshyra-o9bd.14 <this-bead>.

Acceptance criteria: every declared reset shape in the committed pack is exercised by tests (dawn dice regain, per-day all, budget per-period with onlyIfUnused, long-rest gate, days cooldown, hour); timers fire deterministically on clock advance with recorded evidence; double-application is impossible (idempotent per boundary crossing); no model-invented amounts (fail closed on unknown shapes); full verify:worktree green; any pack shape ambiguity discovered is filed as an importer finding rather than silently reinterpreted.
